meta.name: django-expert
meta.description: Use when building Django web applications or REST APIs with Django REST Framework. Invoke when working with settings.py, models.py, manage.py, or any Django project file. Creates Django models with proper indexes, optimizes ORM queries using select_related/prefetch_related, builds DRF serializers and viewsets, and configures JWT authentication. Trigger terms: Django, DRF, Django REST Framework, Django ORM, Django model, serializer, viewset, Python web.

copy.tagline: 构建 Django 模型、ORM 查询和 DRF 接口
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Django 开发 Web 应用或 REST API
copy.tagline_en: Build Django models, ORM queries, and DRF APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building Django web apps or REST APIs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你创建 Django 模型、序列化器和视图集，优化数据库查询，配置 JWT 认证，并编写测试代码。
howto.when: 当你提到 Django、DRF、Django REST Framework、Django ORM 等关键词，或要求处理 settings.py、models.py 等 Django 项目文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Django 文章模型，带标题和作者外键。
为文章模型写一个 DRF 视图集，要求认证才能创建。
优化这个 ORM 查询，避免 N+1 问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you create Django models, serializers, and viewsets, optimize database queries, configure JWT authentication, and write test code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like Django, DRF, Django REST Framework, Django ORM, or when working with Django project files such as settings.py, models.py, etc.

say_en.text: Create a Django Article model with title and author foreign key.
say_en.note: Claude will generate models.py code with indexes and relationships.

say_en.text: Write a DRF viewset for the Article model requiring authentication to create.
say_en.note: Claude will generate views.py and serializers.py code.

say_en.text: Optimize this ORM query to avoid N+1 problem.
say_en.note: Claude will rewrite the query using select_related or prefetch_related.
